summary: SCAM.TJ 3.0 backend + frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passing on public URL (/api/health returns ai_configured=true, POST /api/ai/chat returns non-empty replies in tg/ru/en with proper Cyrillic detection, empty messages returns 400, missing field returns 422, multi-turn context preserves user name 'Ali' across turns). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): onboarding 4 slides with Next+Skip works and persists (ONBOARDING_KEY set, no reappearance after completion); bottom tabs render Асосӣ/Санҷиш/Ёвари AI/Таърих/Танзимот; home quick actions (home-action-link/message/phone) preselect scan segment; home-ai-card opens AI; scanning 'http://paypal-secure-login.xyz/verify' produced result-level='ХАТАРНОК' and saved to history; message scan and phone scan flows verified with result screen (result-level/back/scan-another all present); History shows history-item rows, delete and history-clear-all present; Settings language switch (lang-tg/ru/en) instantly updates UI copy (verified Tajik -> English), settings-privacy/about open info modal with info-close, version 1.0.0 shown; AI Helper: ai-input+ai-send present, send button aria-disabled=true when input empty, ai-suggest-0/1/2 chips visible, user bubble appears then assistant bubble (Tajik reply arrived in ~6s with plain-text formatting per system prompt). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected. Minor: console warning about deprecated 'shadow*' style props (should migrate to boxShadow).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, but should be migrated across components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius.

action_items: Optional: migrate React Native shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence deprecation warning (RN 0.76+ web/DOM style).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes mongodb _id from response models (uses Pydantic ChatResponse) — good.
AI key fallback (GEMINI_API_KEY -> EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) with try/except per key is a clean pattern.
CORS is allow_origins=['*'] which is fine for this public preview; consider tightening in production.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly for API calls (same-origin OK).
All interactive elements have proper testID coverage.
seed_data_creation: One AI chat message row inserted into ai_messages collection via multi-turn test (session_id='TEST_multi_turn_session'). Local scan history: 2 test items created in AsyncStorage via UI (paypal dangerous link, prize message).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://fraud-detector-138.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest suite already present in /app/backend/tests. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. For UI, use mobile viewport 390x844 and set localStorage.scam_tj_onboarding_done_v1='true' to skip onboarding. Tab navigation on web: click text=Таърих/Ёвари AI/Танзимот works for label-based clicks, but home-ai-card is the most reliable AI entry. AI replies typically arrive in 5-10s in Tajik/Russian/English matching req.lang.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Everything requested in the review works as specified.
